string.name: desc

string.name: desc

string.name: name
string.value: Lump of Energy

string.name: desc
string.value: Creates energy using the Energy Conversion Device.

string.value: Surprise Style Stamp

string.name: desc
string.value: A stamp you'll receive for exchanging in a Surprise Style Box item. Collect enough and you can trade them in for a Mystical Surprise Style Box.

string.value: Christmas Tree Decoration

string.name: desc
string.value: Decorate a tree by giving it to Black-nosed Fur at White Christmas Hill.

string.name: name
string.value: Novice Secret Mine Ticket

string.name: desc
string.value: #cCrafting Grand Opening#\nA special gift from Cole for level 1-2 miners. Lets you enter the secret mine through the portal in the lower level of #cArdentmill#. The mine has a #c10 minute time limit#.\nYou can enter 3 times a day.

string.name: desc
string.value: A ticket that allows you to enter Spiegelmann's Monster Park. Only grants access to dungeons that are level 60-95.

string.value: Cherry Blossom Petal

string.name: desc
string.value: A cherry blossom petal from Henesys. Gather up 20 of them and bring them to the Flower Fairy to receive a gift.

string.name: name
string.value: Dolphin Food

string.name: desc
string.value: Food enjoyed by dolphins. When pink dolphin appears, you can talk to the dolphin and offer up some food.

string.name: desc
string.value: A treasure hunt note with a picture of a bomb. This probably means your lose.\n#cYou can gather up these 'You Lose' notes and trade them for something tasty from Hooper.
